# Consumer Disputes and Fraud drive dispute volume at stable levels; Processing Errors win rate declined

| Reason Category | Disputes | Disputed $ | Win Rate | Friendly Fraud Rate |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Consumer Disputes | 210 [F1] → 210 [F2] | $129K [F1] → $125K [F2] | 56.1% [F1] → 53.0% [F2] (resolved only) | 0.0% [F1,F2] |
| Fraud | 126 [F3] → 126 [F4] | $81K [F3] → $79K [F4] | 42.4% [F3] → 44.1% [F4] (resolved only) | 100.0% [F3,F4] |
| Processing Errors | 26 [F5] → 26 [F6] | $16K [F5] → $15K [F6] | 64.0% [F5] → 50.0% [F6] (resolved only) | 0.0% [F5,F6] |

- Dispute counts held flat across all reason categories from 2024-07-31 to 2026-06-30, with Consumer Disputes representing 58% (210 of 362 total) [F1,F2,F3,F4,F5,F6]
- All Fraud disputes flagged as friendly fraud (100.0%) [F3,F4], while Consumer Disputes and Processing Errors show 0.0% friendly fraud rates [F1,F2,F5,F6]
- Processing Errors win rate dropped 14 percentage points from 64.0% [F5] to 50.0% [F6]; market-wide CFPB complaints rose from 4,155 [F1,F3,F5] to 4,213 [F2,F4,F6] between comparable months

## Data Coverage
2024-07-31 through 2026-06-30
